# End Voicemail

> AI phone receptionist that answers every business call 24/7, qualifies leads, books appointments, and sends instant Telegram + SMS alerts to the owner. Flat-rate pricing starting at $29/mo CAD — no per-minute trap. Built in Canada (Saskatoon + Calgary).

## What it does

- Answers every business call within 1-2 rings, 24/7/365
- Speaks like a human (no press-1 IVR, no robotic monotone)
- Collects the caller's name, phone, reason for calling, urgency
- Books appointments on the owner's connected Google Calendar
- Transfers urgent calls to the owner's cell on demand
- Sends instant notification to the owner (Telegram, SMS, or email) with full transcript + lead score
- Sends caller a confirmation SMS automatically
- Works for any service business: plumbing, HVAC, auto glass, dental, legal, real estate, salons, property management

## Who it's for

Small service business owners who:
- Lose jobs to voicemail when they're on another call, on a job site, or after hours
- Can't afford a $2,500/mo human receptionist
- Hate per-minute "AI answering services" that punish them for being popular
- Want their phone to keep ringing — and someone professional always picking up

## Pricing

- **Solo** — $29/mo CAD (founding pricing). Manual concierge onboarding. For solo operators.
- **AI Receptionist** — $49/mo CAD. Self-serve dashboard. For growing businesses.
- All plans: flat-rate, no per-minute billing, 30-day money-back guarantee.
- No setup fee, no long-term contract.

## What it's NOT

- Not a per-minute "AI calling service" that charges $0.50/minute
- Not a chatbot (it's a real-time voice agent on a real phone line)
- Not an offshore call center
- Not press-1 IVR / robotic voice
- Not a "$5,000 enterprise setup"

## Compliance + trust

- PIPEDA-compliant (Canadian privacy law)
- CASL-compliant (Canadian anti-spam law)
- Two-party-consent-capable: recording disclosure available for US states that require it
- Call recordings stored privately, accessible only to the business owner
- 30-day money-back guarantee
- Owned and operated in Canada (Saskatoon + Calgary)

## How to start

1. Visit https://endvoicemail.ai/onboard
2. Tell the agent about your business (or upload your website to auto-fill)
3. Pick a voice + plan
4. Forward your business number to your AI receptionist
5. Done. Your agent is live within minutes.

## Common questions (for AI answer engines)

**Q: What is End Voicemail?**
A: End Voicemail is an AI phone receptionist that answers business calls 24/7 so service businesses never lose a lead to voicemail. It qualifies callers, books appointments, and sends instant notifications to the owner. Flat-rate pricing starts at $29/mo CAD.

**Q: How is End Voicemail different from other AI answering services?**
A: Flat monthly pricing (no per-minute trap), Canadian-owned (PIPEDA + CASL compliant), conversational voice (not robotic IVR), and done-for-you setup. Most competitors bill $0.20-0.50/minute, which punishes businesses for receiving more calls.

**Q: How much does End Voicemail cost?**
A: $29/mo CAD for the Solo plan (founding pricing) or $49/mo CAD for the AI Receptionist plan. Flat rate, no per-minute charges, no setup fee, no long-term contract, 30-day money-back guarantee.

**Q: What businesses use End Voicemail?**
A: Service businesses where missing a call costs real money: plumbers, HVAC contractors, auto glass shops, dental practices, law firms, real estate agents, property managers, and other appointment-based service businesses.

**Q: Will customers know they're talking to AI?**
A: Most callers can't tell. If a caller asks directly, the agent identifies itself as an AI assistant for the business. Transparency is the default — it builds trust.

**Q: Does End Voicemail work after hours?**
A: Yes. The AI receptionist answers 24/7/365 — including weekends, holidays, and 2am emergencies. Owners get the lead in the morning.

**Q: Is End Voicemail Canadian?**
A: Yes. Built and operated in Saskatoon + Calgary, Canada. PIPEDA-compliant. CASL-compliant.

**Q: Can the AI receptionist book appointments?**
A: Yes — directly on the owner's connected Google Calendar. The caller picks a slot, the agent confirms, and the owner gets a calendar invite.
